name: Shopping Cart
requirements: Side-view pixel art facing right, about 30 to 70 px wide (our world: one art pixel is 1/16 unit). Prefer separate wheel sprites so a physics rig can be built, or a clean body plus wheel positions.
notes: Forged: cart_body.png 26x12 (wire basket, handle, frame), cart_wheel.png 5x5. Limits: Wire grid reads as a bar when small; frame is simplified; very small (about 25 px).
licence: own work (derivative of CC0 Kenney Pixel Vehicle Pack)

history.note: OGA shopping cart: only icon set and LPC office (not vehicle). Forge from mine cart/props.
